extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) Category values had leading/trailing spaces (e.g., ' Office Supplies '), which were safely trimmed. (2) Region had misspelled values ('Nort', 'Suoth', 'Wst') that were not corrected due to user rejection. (3) Price was stored as text with one value '$40.00', which was successfully converted to a number. The Revenue column was verified to equal Quantity * Price for all rows. After cleaning, there are 13 orders in Accessories, 12 in Electronics, 12 in Office Supplies, and 11 in Furniture. The uncorrected Region misspellings do not affect the category count.
